name: Every Letter
source: Go through a day of your new job as a letter writer, typing everything from casual hellos to love letters and theater scripts.  Enjoy a light story, over a dozen possible letter requests, and beautiful hand drawn art.
translation: 度过你作为一名写信人的新工作的一天，输入从随意的问候到情书和戏剧脚本的所有内容。享受轻松的故事、十多个可能的信件请求以及精美的手绘艺术。
